- Antitrust & competition


September 26, 2024


**Charlie Rooke & Philipp Leibfried**


## Summary


Recently, Burford posed questions to litigation experts in Spain on the impact of the Draft Law on Collective Actions (“DLCA”) on Spanish collective redress. Their perspective is gathered below.
